name: Gibeah

related_people.name: Jonathan

related_people.name: Kish
related_people.role: Saul's father, whose lost donkeys sent Saul from this town to Samuel

related_people.name: Mephibosheth
related_people.role: a son of Saul, handed to the Gibeonites and hanged at this town

related_people.name: Michal
related_people.role: Saul's daughter of this town, who lowered David from a window to escape

related_people.name: Rizpah
related_people.role: Saul's concubine, who kept vigil over her hanged sons at this town

related_people.name: Saul
related_people.role: Israel's first king, who ruled from this, his hometown

description: A Benjaminite town whose men's horrific crime against a Levite's concubine triggered a civil war that nearly wiped out the tribe of Benjamin (Judges 19-20). It later became the hometown and capital of Israel's first king, Saul, whose family — including Jonathan and Michal — is repeatedly identified with the place (1 Samuel 10:26; 11:4).
